Package edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services

Class BibTexSynthesisService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.BibTexSynthesisService
@Service public class BibTexSynthesisService extends Object
Builds a raw BibTeX string from a ResolvedWork, so it can be fed through the existing, already-tested BibTexConverterService.parseToEntries(java.lang.String, int) rather than hand-building a BibTexEntry and duplicating its validation/normalization.

Field values are passed through LaTeXNormalizationService (some upstream bibliographic data — especially older ACM/IEEE deposits — carries literal LaTeX escapes like Schr{\"o}der even in an otherwise-JSON API response) and any leftover stray {}/{} characters are stripped. See docs/design/OpenAlex-MVP-to-full-tiered-fallback-engine.md.
